text_to_image_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Premium photorealistic wardrobe catalog asset. Portrait 2:3, pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio illumination, realistic fabric and metal texture, subtle contact shadows, whole object uncropped with generous margin. No captions, price labels, watermarks, surroundings or people. Garments: White cropped crew-neck T-shirt with pale blue small graphic, dark blue high-waisted frayed short denim shorts, black knee socks, tall dark gray folded-shaft biker boots with black straps, buckles and thick black platform soles. Show one front-facing assembled outfit using hollow invisible-mannequin display, natural volume but absolutely no body, skin, head, hands, legs, visible mannequin or stand. Exclude ALL detachable accessories: bags, hats, eyeglasses, belts, watches, jewelry and handheld props. Integral garment trims remain. Show hollow inner neck and cuffs.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Change ONLY the entire black and gray background to pure uniform opaque WHITE (#FFFFFF), clean seamless white studio background. Keep the white cropped bow-print T-shirt, belt-free blue frayed denim shorts with original waistband button, black socks, gray tall biker boots and every garment position, shape, texture unchanged. No dark vignette, no gradient, no halo. Soft subtle light gray contact shadows only. No person, body or mannequin. Portrait 2:3.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
